schema_note: Each figure is an OBJECT (value + provenance + verifiability), not a bare number, so this file is understandable ALONE. JN-E DERIVES each figure from v4+CKAN and ASSERTS derived==value here. Legitimate change = append a NEW timestamped baseline (EVIDENCE-append-only); NEVER hand-edit a value to match drifted code.
data_flow: raw CPRA xlsx (BP_Annual Permit Report 2018-2022 + 2023-2025) -> JN-A ingestion (events, one row per permit-milestone; dedup of cross-file overlap) -> JN-C classification (event_classifications: housing_role + net_units, reversible labels) -> gated corrections (C2/C3/C-multifamily/dedup47, each an audited write) -> THIS reconciliation. CKAN does NOT appear anywhere in that chain: it enters ONLY at the comparison step (our derived number vs the city's claim). The single load-bearing invariant: if CKAN ever flows INTO a derived number, the reconciliation is circular and void.

verifiability_contract.oracle_not_source: CKAN/HCD mirror is the reconcile-TARGET, never a derivation input. We compare to it; we never compute from it. mirror==live was confirmed 2026-06-17.
verifiability_contract.city_silence_never_proof: The city not crediting a unit is NOT evidence we are over; nor is the city crediting a unit evidence we are under. Each side is adjudicated from OUR independent evidence (CPRA + assessor + documents).
verifiability_contract.count_once: One building = one count, at the unit-bearing completion phase. Phases (foundation/podium/superstructure) of one building are NOT separate units.
verifiability_contract.null_not_zero: A missing unit count is UNKNOWN, never 0. Below-market/uncounted gaps are flagged needs-acquisition, never fabricated or zeroed.
verifiability_contract.hold_dont_adopt: A city figure we cannot independently reproduce is HELD, not adopted. Adopting it would be oracle-as-source (circular).

ledger.note: How co_completions (3,676) was reached from the pre-corrections baseline, step by step (each step a gated audited write). Additive documentation of the SAME 3,676 — the deltas SUM to co_completions; not a new result. VIZ 1 (waterfall) derives from this.
ledger.reconciles_to: co_completions (3676) — VIZ 1 asserts sum(deltas) == that value

co_completions.derivation: COUNT/SUM(net_units) of finaled new_unit master permits, net_units>0 (verdict-driven per ADR-002); event_type_code='permit_finaled' AND housing_role='new_unit' AND is_master=1.
co_completions.what_would_change_it: a new gated write; harvesting the +147 held under-count; adjudicating the -150 residual
co_completions.how_to_reverify: re-run JN-E §2 against the pinned v4 sha
co_completions.uncertainty: this is our LOWER honest bound vs the city's 4,022 (the -150 residual is real housing we may under-count); NOT a claim the city is wrong

city_co_total.what_would_change_it: the city filing a corrected/amended APR; a fresh CKAN pull
city_co_total.how_to_reverify: re-run JN-E §2 summing CO_* tiers on the pinned mirror
city_co_total.uncertainty: this is the city's CLAIM, used only as the comparison target — it is never an input to our numbers
city_co_total.provenance: Berkeley submitted HCD APR Table A2, mirrored from CKAN

co_gap.source: computed in JN-E §2 from the two figures above
co_gap.uncertainty: a NET of large offsetting flows (see decomposition), NOT a uniform shortfall

bp_issued.derivation: SUM(net_units) over FIRST building-permit issuance, PERMIT-level (one row per source_record_key): event_type_code='permit_issued' AND housing_role='new_unit' AND is_master=1, deduped to distinct source_record_key (MIN event_id). Event-level is 3946; the 1-unit gap is one residual dup-permit.
bp_issued.what_would_change_it: the full-city BP-stream acquisition (the ADU/infill tail not modeled as projects)
bp_issued.how_to_reverify: re-run JN-E §10 at permit-level on the pinned sha
bp_issued.uncertainty: COVERAGE-LIMITED — tracked-project BPs only, NOT Berkeley's full permit stream; an internal lower bound
bp_issued.retires: the prior un-provenanced 4,911 figure — see JN-E §10 (4,911 had no runnable provenance and was event-inflated; a number you cannot re-derive is a number you cannot trust)

documented_not_gated.note: Decomposition of the -346. These are heuristic/held/approximate (NOT exactly-reproducible), so they are DOCUMENTED here with provenance but NOT hard-gated — JN-E displays them with caveats, the gate only enforces the 4 hard figures above. The signed components do not sum to -346 because the over (-199) and dedup (-47) are ALREADY corrected (folded into co_completions=3676); the under (+147) and residual (-150) are the open delta.

permit_mismatch_noise.derivation: reverse-direction triage: our counted completions the city credits under a DIFFERENT permit#/ID (same parcel). Nets to zero — both sides count the unit, different identifier.
permit_mismatch_noise.verifiability_concern: the MATCHING — a 'mismatch' could be a real disagreement if the APN/address join is wrong; sized by APN+magnitude, approximate.

phase_over_corrected.derivation: 3 phased multifamily buildings double-counted (both phases new_unit); foundation/podium phases demoted to subsidiary/0, completion kept. count-once.

phase_under_held.derivation: 3 multifamily completion permits classified ambiguous (B2021-03302 +69, B2018-03422 +55, B2016-05139 +23). Our WorkDescriptions carry NO unit count, so the ONLY source of 69/55/23 is the city.
phase_under_held.verifiability_concern: SHARPEST — adopting +147 = oracle-as-source (circular). The ONLY independent verification path is the Accela/architect-plan harvest; until then these are HELD-not-verified.

adu_recall.derivation: manufactured-home / within-existing-home ADUs held ambiguous; small finaled-CO recall gap.
adu_recall.verifiability_concern: lower bound; the broader adu_flag-nonhousing-role bucket is not fully sized.

dedup_corrected.derivation: 4 permits double-counted via duplicate file-row finaled events (CPRA two-file overlap); collapsed to one (B2014-05786 -44 + 3x-1). Plus the 2,870-event structural dedup (CO-neutral).

residual.derivation: after both directions corrected, the residual is genuine real-housing-the-city-counts-we-don't; structural triage (COVERAGE/DETECTION/TIMING/POSSIBLE_CITY_OVER).
residual.verifiability_concern: the sensitive direction — requires per-permit INDEPENDENT proof (e.g. the 39-unit congregate CITY_UNDER candidate), never CKAN-silence. Not closeable by adoption.
